items.labelEn: PCIe 4.0 per-lane data rate
items.labelFr: Débit par voie PCIe 4.0
items.conditions: PCI Express 4.0 Base Specification Version 1.0; raw signaling rate per lane, per direction, before 128b/130b encoding overhead.
items.quote: delivers high performance 16GT/s data rates with flexible lane width configurations
items.confidenceNotes: Press-release text read on a third-party reproduction because pcisig.com refused the request (403). No x16 GB/s value in this release.

items.labelEn: PCIe 5.0 per-lane raw bit rate
items.labelFr: Débit brut par voie PCIe 5.0
items.conditions: PCI Express 5.0 Base Specification; raw bit rate per lane, 128b/130b encoding.
items.quote: Delivers 32 GT/s raw bit rate and up to 128 GB/s via x16 configuration
items.confidenceNotes: Secondary hosting of the PCI-SIG press release.

items.labelEn: PCIe 5.0 x16 total bandwidth (both directions)
items.labelFr: Bande passante totale PCIe 5.0 x16 (deux sens)
items.conditions: x16 link; figure counts both directions combined (about 64 GB/s per direction, cf. a quote in the same release: 'doubles that again to 64 GB/second').
items.quote: Delivers 32 GT/s raw bit rate and up to 128 GB/s via x16 configuration
items.confidenceNotes: The release does not say 'bidirectional' explicitly; the per-direction interpretation rests on the analyst quote in the same text and on NVIDIA's 'PCIe Gen5: 128GB/s' for H100 (src-nvidia-h100). Display as total, not per direction.

items.labelEn: PCIe 6.0 per-lane raw data rate
items.labelFr: Débit brut par voie PCIe 6.0
items.conditions: PCI Express 6.0 specification; PAM4 signaling, FLIT mode.
items.quote: 64 GT/s raw data rate and up to 256 GB/s via x16 configuration
items.confidenceNotes: Secondary hosting of the PCI-SIG press release (Business Wire original returned 403).

items.labelEn: PCIe 6.0 x16 total bandwidth (both directions)
items.labelFr: Bande passante totale PCIe 6.0 x16 (deux sens)
items.conditions: x16 link, both directions combined (about 128 GB/s per direction).
items.quote: 64 GT/s raw data rate and up to 256 GB/s via x16 configuration
items.confidenceNotes: Direction not stated in this text; same convention as the PCIe 5.0 '128 GB/s' figure (2x per generation).

items.labelEn: CXL 3.0 data rate
items.labelFr: Débit CXL 3.0
items.conditions: Compute Express Link 3.0; per lane, built on PCIe 6.0 electricals.
items.quote: CXL 3.0 specification doubles the data rate to 64GTs with no added latency over CXL 2.0.
items.confidenceNotes: '64GTs' is written without slash in the source. The 'no added latency' claim is not quantified.

items.labelEn: USB low-speed signaling rate
items.labelFr: Débit de signalisation USB low-speed
items.conditions: USB 1.x/2.0 low-speed mode (keyboards, mice of the USB 1.x era).
items.locator: Section 7.1 introduction bullet list, p. 17 (PDF p. 45)
items.quote: A limited capability low-speed signaling mode is also defined at 1.5 Mb/s.

items.labelEn: USB full-speed signaling rate
items.labelFr: Débit de signalisation USB full-speed
items.conditions: USB 1.x/2.0 full-speed signaling bit rate (gross, not payload).
items.quote: The USB full-speed signaling bit rate is 12 Mb/s.

items.labelEn: USB 2.0 high-speed signaling rate
items.labelFr: Débit de signalisation USB 2.0 high-speed
items.conditions: USB 2.0 high-speed signaling bit rate (gross).
items.quote: The USB high-speed signaling bit rate is 480 Mb/s.

items.labelEn: USB 3.2 two-lane transfer rate (20 Gbps)
items.labelFr: Débit USB 3.2 sur deux voies (20 Gbit/s)
items.conditions: USB 3.2, two lanes of 10 Gbps over USB Type-C.
items.quote: allowing for up to two lanes of 10Gbps operation to realize a 20Gbps data transfer rate

items.labelEn: USB4 maximum data rate (80 Gbps cables)
items.labelFr: Débit maximal USB4 (câbles 80 Gbit/s)
items.conditions: USB4 two-lane operation over 80 Gbps certified cables (USB4 Version 2.0 capability).
items.quote: Two-lane operation using existing USB Type-C cables and up to 80 Gbps operation over 80 Gbps certified cables
items.confidenceNotes: Page gives no year and no 40 Gbps figure; era 2022 is not from this page (unverified, can be set to null).

items.labelEn: USB full/low-speed frame period
items.labelFr: Période de trame USB full/low-speed
items.conditions: USB full-speed and low-speed bus time base (Start-of-Frame every 1 ms).
items.locator: Section 5.3.3 Frames and Microframes, p. 36 (PDF p. 64)
items.quote: USB establishes a 1 millisecond time base called a frame on a full-/low-speed bus

items.labelEn: USB 2.0 high-speed microframe period
items.labelFr: Période de micro-trame USB 2.0 high-speed
items.conditions: USB 2.0 high-speed bus time base.
items.quote: a 125 µs time base called a microframe on a high-speed bus

items.labelEn: USB full-speed interrupt endpoint shortest polling period
items.labelFr: Période d'interrogation minimale d'un point de terminaison interrupt USB full-speed
items.conditions: USB 2.0 spec, full-speed interrupt endpoint (typical of HID mice/keyboards); requested period 1 to 255 ms. The host only guarantees the interval is no longer than requested.
items.locator: Section 5.7.4 Interrupt Transfer Bus Access Constraints, p. 51 (PDF p. 79)
items.quote: A full-speed endpoint can specify a desired period from 1 ms to 255 ms.

items.labelEn: USB low-speed interrupt endpoint shortest polling period
items.labelFr: Période d'interrogation minimale d'un point de terminaison interrupt USB low-speed
items.conditions: USB 2.0 spec, low-speed interrupt endpoint.
items.quote: Low-speed endpoints are limited to specifying only 10 ms to 255 ms.

items.calculation: f = 1 / T_min = 1 / 1 ms = 1000 Hz; input item: usb-fs-interrupt-min-period
items.labelEn: Maximum USB full-speed interrupt polling rate
items.labelFr: Fréquence maximale d'interrogation interrupt USB full-speed
items.conditions: Full-speed interrupt endpoint polled at its shortest allowed period (1 ms); the usual '1000 Hz' gaming-mouse figure.
items.quote: A full-speed endpoint can specify a desired period from 1 ms to 255 ms.
items.confidenceNotes: Upper bound; actual rate depends on the bInterval chosen by the device and on the host.

items.calculation: T = 2^(bInterval-1) x 125 µs with bInterval = 1 -> 125 µs; f = 1/125 µs = 8000 Hz; input items: usb-hs-microframe (and formula in Section 5.7.4)
items.labelEn: Maximum USB high-speed interrupt polling rate
items.labelFr: Fréquence maximale d'interrogation interrupt USB high-speed
items.conditions: High-speed interrupt endpoint with bInterval = 1, i.e. period (2^(1-1)) x 125 µs = 125 µs.
items.quote: up to the shortest period defined by the USB (125 µs microframe or 1 ms frame)
items.confidenceNotes: Upper bound set by the spec; the '8000 Hz mouse' marketing figure matches but was not checked against a product.

items.labelEn: HDMI 8K60 refresh rate
items.labelFr: Fréquence de rafraîchissement HDMI 8K60
items.conditions: Video format 8K at 60 Hz supported by HDMI 2.2 (also by HDMI 2.1).
items.quote: supports a range of higher video resolutions and refresh rates including 8K60 and 4K120
items.confidenceNotes: '8K60' notation: 60 = refresh rate in Hz. This is a format supported by the interface, not a display property.

items.labelEn: HDMI 4K120 refresh rate
items.labelFr: Fréquence de rafraîchissement HDMI 4K120
items.conditions: Video format 4K at 120 Hz supported by HDMI 2.2.
items.quote: supports a range of higher video resolutions and refresh rates including 8K60 and 4K120

items.labelEn: HDMI 2.2 maximum bandwidth
items.labelFr: Bande passante maximale HDMI 2.2
items.conditions: HDMI 2.2 with Ultra96 cable, Fixed Rate Link.
items.quote: Higher 96Gbps bandwidth and next-gen HDMI Fixed Rate Link technology
items.confidenceNotes: Era not on the page.

items.calculation: T = 1 / 60 Hz = 16.667 ms; input item: hdmi-8k60-refresh
items.labelEn: Frame duration at 60 Hz
items.labelFr: Durée d'une image à 60 Hz
items.conditions: One refresh period at exactly 60 Hz (some broadcast-derived timings use 59.94 Hz, i.e. 16.683 ms).
items.quote: supports a range of higher video resolutions and refresh rates including 8K60 and 4K120

items.calculation: T = 1 / 120 Hz = 8.333 ms; input item: hdmi-4k120-refresh
items.labelEn: Frame duration at 120 Hz
items.labelFr: Durée d'une image à 120 Hz
items.conditions: One refresh period at 120 Hz.
items.quote: supports a range of higher video resolutions and refresh rates including 8K60 and 4K120
